name: enhance ability
lore:
# Codex Arcanum: The Rites of Transcendent Form

*Enhance Ability* is a masterpiece of transmutation, a bridge between the mortal vessel and the Platonic ideal of the wild. To shape its threads is to feel the world’s latent potential hum within your marrow—a tightening of the soul’s fabric until it rings with the resonance of a struck bell.

Visually, the magic manifests as a diaphanous, amber shroud. Depending on the aspect invoked, a ghostly silhouette—the broad antlers of the Bull or the flickering tail of the Fox—ripples over the subject’s form before sinking into their skin as a pulsing, golden glow.

**The Legend of the First Weaver**
It is whispered that the hermit-sage Maelis discovered these rites while trapped in a frozen mountain pass. By observing the effortless grace of the mountain goat and the iron will of the hibernating bear, he realized that magic could mimic the "Divine Blueprint" of nature. He did not invent the spell; he simply learned to listen to the excellence inherent in the Weave, translating the language of the beasts into a formula for the common traveler.
